# What will transcription cost for your audio hours, and who is cheapest?

> Type your monthly audio hours and growth, get every speech-to-text API priced side by side and the volume where self-hosting Whisper starts to win. No account, no upload.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
